notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to King Macar.
King Macar does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, causing a player to mill cards equal to King Macar's toughness.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any opposing creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate the Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
